notes:
v4.6.17 — Universe-bot generation prompt hardened (no more ccxt-class crashes)

🐛 FIXED
• Universe bots generated via Make Bot kept importing ccxt / talib / sklearn — packages that aren't in the frozen APEX bundle and that the frozen Python interpreter can't pip-install. Result: bot crashed with ModuleNotFoundError at line 1 and never wrote its universe file.
• Bots also failed to load .env (so os.environ['ALPACA_API_KEY'] was empty) and 401'd against authenticated endpoints with no fallback, leaving the universe file unchanged.

✨ NEW Make Bot prompt rules for universe bots
• BUNDLED-LIBS ONLY: explicit whitelist (requests, yfinance, pandas, numpy, alpaca-py read-only, stdlib). Forbidden: ccxt, talib, sklearn, openai, anthropic, etc.
• CREDENTIAL LOADING: every generated universe bot must call load_dotenv(APEX_DATA_DIR/.env) at startup so keys are actually in os.environ.
• AUTH-FAILURE FALLBACK: every bot must have a no-auth public-API fallback (CoinGecko for crypto, yfinance for stocks) so a single 401 doesn't break the universe file.
• Bots that can't get data must RETURN without overwriting the .txt — the existing universe stays intact.

Also bundled: the user's own long_crypto_universe.py rewritten on disk to follow all three rules — works immediately with no v4.6.17 install needed.
